items.name: UST 2y 4.85% (+32bp w/w) / 10y 5.12% (+26bp w/w) Fri 13 Nov - biggest weekly rise since Apr 2025
items.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Log Biggest Weekly Jump Since April 2025 / Global bond investors brace for continued volatility
items.claim: By Friday 13 Nov the 2y Treasury yield reached 4.85% (up 32bp on the week, largest weekly gain since late 2024; Tue+Thu combined jump largest since Mar 2023) and the 10y hit 5.12% (up 26bp, steepest weekly climb since the Apr 2025 tariff shock) after Oct CPI +0.4% m/m; a 25bp Dec Fed hike is fully priced, a Jan hike largely priced, and Waller/Logan floated 50bp; swaps price >50bp of average hikes across eight major economies over the next year vs 33bp on 6 Nov.
items.source: TokenPost (13 Nov 06:22 EST) / azat.tv (14 Nov 00:15 UTC+4, data through 13 Nov)
items.sweep_query: 8. sovereign bond stress (+ 1. bond deal pulled OR downsized surfaced tokenpost)
items.note: Thu 12 Nov close per goodman-macro: 2y 4.86% (+13bp), 5y 4.95%, 10y 5.10% (+12bp), 30y 5.43% (+8bp); 2s10s 24bp. Tokenpost published Friday morning saying 'on track' for the weekly move; azat.tv (post-close) states 4.85%/5.12% 'by Friday'. No official settle source fetched; treat 5.12%/4.85% as press levels. Analyst targets cited: 10y 5.5% (Tracy Chen), buy at 5.3% (Boubouras); GS 2027 10y 4.6%.

items.headline: U.K. Gilt Yields Accelerate on Rate-Hike Expectations (Dow Jones)
items.claim: Short-dated gilt yields rose to their highest in more than three years on Friday: the 2y jumped to 5.005% (highest since Oct 2023, last 4.969%) and the 10y traded 5.478%, after Sept GDP +0.2% m/m beat an expected -0.1%; markets price an 82% chance of a Dec BoE hike (from 50% at the start of the week) and fully price three more hikes by mid-2027 beyond November's.
items.source: MarketScreener / Dow Jones Newswires, 13 Nov 2026 05:18 EST
items.sweep_query: 8. sovereign bond stress (targeted gilts Friday check)
items.note: Page header showed 10y 5.478% +0.045 and 30y 5.809%; page table changes (+0.836/+1.024) are inconsistent and likely stale - use article-text levels. Reaction: BoE deputy governor Lombardelli said another hike needed; NIESR's Aikman said one more 25bp unlikely sufficient. No Treasury/Reeves reaction found. Friday official close not obtained (DMO/TE not fetched).

items.name: Rupiah record low 18,241-18,253/USD; Bank Indonesia intervenes in spot/forwards and buys bonds; 10y +4bp to 7.66%
items.headline: Indonesia's central bank intervenes after rupiah hits record low (AFP/Bloomberg, 12 Nov)
items.claim: The rupiah weakened as much as 0.5% to a record 18,241 per dollar (AFP: as much as 18,253 in afternoon trade) on Fed-hike expectations and domestic political turmoil (vice president resignation), prompting Bank Indonesia to intervene in spot, offshore and domestic forwards and buy government bonds in the secondary market; the 10y IDR yield rose 4bp to 7.66%.
items.source: Malay Mail / AFP (12 Nov 2026 17:22 MYT) + Bloomberg via Zack Eiseman ICYMI relay (12 Nov 2026)
items.sweep_query: 1. bond deal pulled OR postponed OR downsized November 14 2026 (relay) + targeted Indonesia search
items.note: FX level/intervention confirmed by AFP wire; bond-buying detail and 10y 7.66% (+4bp) come from the Bloomberg relay only. journalarta fetch failed (client_error); asiaone link resolved to an April 2026 article (17,090 at that time) and was ignored. Rupiah is Asia's worst-performing currency in 2026.
